difficulty_reason: Existence of fibre products and equalizers in a category fibred in groupoids under the listed hypotheses: part (1) via Categories, fibre-product-raises, part (2) by taking the equalizer W -> U of p(a), p(b) in schemes and forming the equalizer of a and b as that of a c and b c, with the universal property checked; the quotient-stack and algebraic-stack cases are settled through the Bootstrap and Algebraic Stacks presentation lemmas. Retained author proof at lines 2876-2911.
